items.name: Dagnar's Journal-Clasp
items.lore: A brass clasp from a mapmaker's journal, engraved with a compass rose.

items.name: Battered-Chest Belt
items.lore: Leather and brass from a chest that crossed Muspelheim.

items.name: Forgemaster's Bracer
items.lore: Fire-dwarf work. It glows at the edges when you're angry.

items.name: Lodestone Ring
items.lore: A sliver of lodestone set in silver. It always points home.

items.name: Ragnvald's Lay-Harp Charm
items.lore: A tiny bronze harp. The song it stands for is either true or famous. Not both.

items.name: Ashbeard Ring
items.lore: A huscarl's ring, scorched black by giant-fire.

items.name: Fire-Giant Thane Belt
items.lore: Broad enough for two men. Cut down, it fits one very well.

items.name: Cinder-Silk Cloak
items.lore: A cloak that cannot burn. The fire giants weave it from something they will not name.

items.name: Ember-Ward Ring
items.lore: Iron, blackened. It's cool to the touch, even here.

items.name: Hound-Hide Belt
items.lore: Scorched hide, oddly supple.

items.name: Vent-Steam Charm
items.lore: A glass bead with steam curling inside it.

items.name: Firecat Fang Torc
items.lore: Fangs that glow faintly red.

items.name: Ash-Road Cloak
items.lore: Grey with ash that never shakes out.

items.name: Ashmonger's Ring
items.lore: A ring of fused ash.

items.name: Soot-Black Bracer
items.lore: Leather blackened in soot. Fire slides off it.

items.name: Flame-Thrower's Charm
items.lore: A little pot of something that burns without fuel.

items.name: Sulphur-Crust Ring
items.lore: Yellow crust over iron. It smells.

items.name: Ant-Queen's Belt
items.lore: Chitin plates, jointed.

items.name: Fire-Salt Pouch Charm
items.lore: A pouch of red salt. It's warm.

items.name: Turncoat's Bracer
items.lore: Dverge-work, the forge-mark scratched off.

items.name: Igniter's Torch-Ring
items.lore: A ring with a tiny flame trapped in the stone.

items.name: Khizil Forge Mantle
items.lore: Forge-black, Khizil's hammer on the back.

items.name: Crackler's Blast-Belt
items.lore: Hung with little clay pots. Empty, now.

items.name: Bone-Ash Ring
items.lore: Pale grey, light as nothing.

items.name: Burnt Sentry's Belt
items.lore: Rusted plates on a scorched strap.

items.name: Old-War Banner Charm
items.lore: A scrap of a banner. A dragon, crossed out.

items.name: Charred Warrior's Bracer
items.lore: Iron, warped by an old, terrible heat.

items.name: Wyrm-Scale Bracer
items.lore: A fire wyrm's scale, still warm.

items.name: Hill-Fire Ring
items.lore: Red stone set in black iron.

items.name: Cinder-Drake Fang Torc
items.lore: A great drake's fang, black and red.

items.name: Brood-Breaker's Belt
items.lore: Thick, scorched, still whole.

items.name: Brood-Egg Shard Charm
items.lore: A shard of a dragon's egg, warm as a hearth.

items.name: Hatchery-Breaker's Mantle
items.lore: The King's blue, scorched and proud of it.

items.name: Brood-Priest's Ring
items.lore: Red scale on gold. Taken off a priest.
